description: (0.5.0) Keyless nodes in RFC-ACDP-0017 chain verification (RFC-ACDP-0021 §10). Behavioral; verdict schema, stage vocabularies and chain KATs are unchanged.

input.golden: kl-001 (controller did:web:agents.example.com:ci, identity oidc https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com / repo:example/pipeline:ref:refs/heads/main, registry did:web:registry.example.com)

scenarios.name: A — bundle carries the attestation context with receipt; controller snapshot lists the identity
B — chosen snapshot does not list the identity
C — attestation context absent from the bundle
D — admitted registry retraction of the attestation, accepted_at <= T

expected.behavior: The node is refused, never ok.

scenarios.name: F — the only revocation candidate for the node's attested fingerprint is keyless-signed and unevaluable (its signer's attester is not in pinned.keyless_attesters); no other revocation applies

expected.behavior: No basis or evidence_time on the stage. The node is unknown, never ok. An applying revocation (revoked) or unplaceable would win over it.
